## Commit format check

- [ ] Title uses a lowercase type prefix (`fix:`, `feat:`, `style:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `test:`)
- [ ] Bullets explain what and why, one line per change
- [ ] `TEST:` section lists the build command + manual verification steps
- [ ] `Change-Id: I<40-char hex>` footer present
- [ ] Commit was made with `git commit -s` (Signed-off-by line)

## For translation PRs

- [ ] New strings reuse the [Settled terms](README.md#settled-terms) table
- [ ] English text was never changed
- [ ] Verified the string renders in the Bangla app language
